full_prompt_en: A natural-light garden photograph looks along a narrow stone path winding between abundant flowering borders. In the foreground, the paving begins near the lower center and leads inward through a dense mix of foliage and blossoms. Lavender-purple flower heads and long blue-green leaves lean in from the left. On the right, pink roses, white clustered blooms, violet spikes, and small rounded green shrubs form overlapping mounds. Farther along, bright magenta and cream flowers repeat in smaller groups, guiding the eye toward a reddish brick wall at the back. Large leafy trees rise above the wall and cast soft partial shade across the garden. The planting feels carefully composed but not rigid: low grasses spill over edges, flowers vary in height, and each color patch transitions into the next through foliage rather than a sharp border. The path remains a clear visual route amid the profusion, its warm stone slabs partly dappled by leaves. The palette is led by many greens—sage, deep leaf green, teal, and olive—punctuated by lilac, rose pink, cream white, yellow, and coral. Soft daylight reveals petal texture and leaf shape without hard flash or dramatic contrast. The nearer flowers have crisp botanical detail; more distant blossoms blend into smaller specks against the trees and wall. The composition is eye-level and immersive, allowing foliage to fill nearly every edge while the path opens a gentle corridor. The image feels tranquil, cultivated, and seasonally full, with natural growth arranged into a continuous rhythm of heights, colors, and textures.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅自然光花园照片沿狭窄石路望入丰盛花境。前景铺石从下方中央附近开始，穿过密集叶丛与花朵向里延伸。薰衣草紫花头与长蓝绿叶从左侧探入。右侧，粉玫瑰、白色簇花、紫色花穗和小圆绿灌木形成重叠丘状体。沿路更远处，亮洋红与奶油白花以更小群组重复，把目光引向后方红砖墙。大叶树高过墙顶，在花园投下柔和局部阴影。栽植经过细心布局却不僵硬：低草漫过边，花高不一，各色片块经叶丛过渡，而非硬边界。小路在丰盛中仍是清楚视觉路线，暖石板上有部分叶影斑点。配色由多种绿领衔——鼠尾草、深叶绿、青绿、橄榄——穿插丁香紫、玫瑰粉、奶油白、黄与珊瑚色。柔日光显示花瓣纹理与叶形，没有硬闪光或戏剧反差。近处花有清晰植物细节；远花在树与墙前混成较小色点。构图在视平线高度，沉浸感强，让叶子填满几乎每条边缘，而路开出柔和走廊。画面宁静、经栽培且当季丰满，自然生长被安排成高度、颜色与纹理的连续节奏。
style_prompt_en: Natural-light garden photography organizes a dense field of organic detail around a narrow receding path. Numerous green values—sage, olive, teal, and deep leaf green—make the dominant connected mass, while lilac, rose, cream, yellow, and coral occur as repeated clustered accents. Near petals and leaves have crisp fine texture; distant growth merges into softer small marks. Gentle daylight and dappled shade give rounded plant masses dimensionality without hard cast shadows or artificial gloss. Irregular edges overlap freely, with low forms spilling into the central route and taller canopies enclosing the upper frame. The path supplies a quiet leading line, while color patches step through the scene at varied heights. A warm masonry strip and dark tree shapes provide subtle structural anchors behind the profusion. The composition feels immersive yet legible, balancing cultivated rhythm with the softness and variation of living growth.
style_prompt_zh: 自然光花园摄影把密集有机细节围绕一条窄小退远路径组织。多种绿色明度——鼠尾草、橄榄、青绿、深叶绿——组成主导相连体量，丁香、玫瑰、奶油、黄与珊瑚作为重复簇状重点。近处花瓣叶片有清晰细纹，远处生长形体融成更柔的小点。温和日光与斑驳树荫赋予圆浑植物团块体积，而无硬投影或人造光泽。不规则边缘自由叠压，低植株漫入中央路线，高树冠围住画幅上部。小路提供安静引导线，各色片块在不同高度逐步进入场景。暖砌墙色带与深树形在丰盛背后提供微妙结构锚点。构图沉浸却可读，平衡栽培节奏与活物生长的柔和变化。
theme_en: A narrow stone path winds through richly layered flowering borders in a walled garden
theme_zh: 狭窄石径穿过围墙花园中层次丰盛的花境
name: Gertrude Jekyll
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
